author: SA Editor Yoel Minkoff
title: Songwriters just claimed a major victory in the fight for be
text:
Songwriters just claimed a major victory in the fight for better pay from streaming giants as the U.S. Copyright Royalty Board bumped up streaming revenue rates over the next five years to at least a 15.1%, from a previous 10.5%.
The 43.8% pay raise is the "biggest increase in CRB history," according to the National Music Publishers' Association, and will affect many companies including Alphabet ( GOOG , GOOGL ), Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN ), Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ), Spotify (Private: MUSIC ), and Pandora (NYSE: P ).
